answer: One effective defense against Sybil attacks in AI agent economies is requiring each agent to lock a non-fungible jade stake as an economic anchor while continuously publishing a verified activity thread. Creating fake identities becomes costly because every clone must acquire and immobilize its own jade, and the ongoing thread of signed proofs is checked by peers who slash incomplete or duplicated anchors. This raises the attacker’s capital and operational expense far above any gain from flooding the network with false agents.
